hypothesis.statement: On a real eyes-closed posterior EEG channel (eegmmidb S002R02, POz), the newly-authored partialAutocorrelation (Durbin-Levinson on the biased ACF) reproduces statsmodels.tsa.pacf(method='ldb') BIT-FOR-BIT across lags; the lag-1 PACF equals the lag-1 ACF (the definitional identity); and the lag-2 PACF is strongly negative (an oscillatory, AR(2)-like structure characteristic of the alpha rhythm).

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel POz (posterior), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: partialAutocorrelation equals statsmodels.tsa.pacf(method='ldb') to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9) across lags
